# EDGE Clubhouse · Elevation Review

Interactive elevation presentation for the EDGE Clubhouse, Shankarpalli (Ankura Homes).

- The landing scene follows the viewer's time of day and opens a different design option on every visit
- Live 3D models of Option A and Option 01, built from the Studio Infinite LLP plans (For Approval, 19-08-2026)
- Nine concept boards with materials and palettes, side-by-side comparison, plan sheets and next steps

## Publish on GitHub Pages

1. Upload everything in this folder to the root of a GitHub repository, keeping the `img` folder.
2. In the repository, open **Settings → Pages**.
3. Under **Build and deployment**, choose **Deploy from a branch**, branch **main**, folder **/ (root)**, then **Save**.
4. After about a minute the site is live at `https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/REPOSITORY-NAME/`.

Concept renders are illustrative; the architect's drawings take precedence.
